title: Blank finance kit
summary: Start from scratch with the full finance UI kit already installed.
ideas: Build a landing page and a simple dashboard for my fintech idea
Add a sign-up flow with a clear privacy and consent screen
Create a pricing page that explains every fee in plain language
guide: Empty app: only src/App.jsx is a placeholder. The UI kit is in src/components/ui (shadcn/ui style: button, card, input, tabs, dialog, select, table, badge, progress, switch, accordion...), finance blocks as named exports from src/components/finance/AppShell, /blocks (PageHeader, StatCard, DemoBanner, TrustNote, EmptyState) and /charts, helpers in src/lib (money formatting, loan maths, Luhn, seeded fake data).
